caption: The drawing depicts a single upright object resembling a traditional barber pole. It consists of a cylindrical column with a spiraling red, white, and blue stripe pattern running diagonally along its body. The pole is topped with a spherical golden-yellow finial resting on a red neck and a short blue-and-white collar. Below the collar, a blue ring decorated with golden motifs encircles the pole. The base of the pole features green and gold accents before transitioning into a rectangular black plinth with a textured, worn appearance. The background is plain, light beige, with no other objects or elements present. The artist's name, "EMILE CERO," appears in black capital letters in the bottom right corner.
title: Barber Pole
